name: Create Fire Drill Evacuation Map
description:
A school safety coordinator needs a digital classroom evacuation map to project during fire safety week. Create a single-page ActivInspire flipchart that acts as a floor plan.

Requirements:
1. Create a new flipchart.
2. Page Title: Add text 'Fire Drill Route' or 'Evacuation Plan'.
3. Room Layout: Draw a large rectangle for the room outline.
4. Furniture: Draw 1 rectangle labeled 'Teacher Desk' and at least 4 shapes (rectangles/circles) representing 'Student Tables'.
5. Exit: Label one area of the room as 'Door' or 'Exit'.
6. Route: Draw at least 3 arrows indicating the path from the student tables toward the door.
7. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/fire_evacuation_plan.flipchart'.
